data.title: 红莲 · 榻榻米间的微醺索吻
data.description: 居酒屋隐秘包厢内酒香弥漫，微醺的红莲浴衣衣襟滑散露出精致锁骨与裹胸。平日豪爽的剑客整个人软绵绵地压在你身上，满脸酡红，带着甜美酒气低头向你索吻。
data.location: private izakaya tatami room with dim paper lantern light
data.action: tipsy and blushing, yukata collar sliding open over chest, leaning heavily against partner on tatami mat, flushed cheeks, whisper at lips
data.lighting: warm amber glow from low-hanging paper lanterns
data.mood: intoxicated passion, disarmed warrior vulnerability, demanding sweet affection
data.promptProse: Tipsy with blushing cheeks on tatami, Scarlet leans in with her yukata loosely open, demanding a kiss with intoxicated devotion.
data.animaCaption: A tipsy Scarlet leaning close on tatami with an open yukata collar.
